mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned underground silver mine (Castrovirreyna district, Huancavelica), held via Sociedad Minera Reliquias S.A.C. Includes the Caudalosa mine, 2,600 tpd concentrator (permitted to 2,000 tpd), tailings dam (2-yr capacity), 370-person camp. Operated by CMC 2005-2015 (avg >1 Moz Ag/yr 2009-2014). Transferred from exploration to development stage Sept 1, 2025 ($25.8M carrying value; no impairment). Commercial production commenced Q3 2026 (concentrate production began Sept 2026; shipments expected Oct 2026) - post-dates FY2025, which had zero production. 2024 PEA (eff. May 14, 2024): pre-tax NPV5% C$107M, IRR 57%; post-tax NPV5% C$85M, IRR 51%. 2024 MRE (resources only; at OSC's request the company confirmed NO NI 43-101 reserves exist at Reliquias): M&I 12.8 Moz AgEq @ 277 g/t AgEq (~1.44 Mt); Inferred 16.0 Moz AgEq @ 266 g/t AgEq (~1.87 Mt). Caudalosa holds a historic resource of 35.6 Moz AgEq. Targeting 800 tpd processing in H2 2027; 45,000 t stockpile for ramp-up.
mines.processing: 2,600 tpd concentrator (Caudalosa plant) producing Ag-Pb-Zn-Cu concentrates
